big_picture: Execute Programme #393 as an auditable optimization campaign for reproducible one-month net trading return while preserving V1 and later evidence boundaries.
why_zoomed_in: Programme setup registered the variable/search design but did not execute optimization; issue #424 establishes the shared execution, scoring, and trial-accounting layer needed before family searches.
tested_role_target_horizon: Issue #424 tests the optimization harness itself on bounded pre-2023 development evidence; it does not select a V2 champion.

historical_facts.observed: Programme-003 provides reusable pre-2023 exact-source reconstruction and execution primitives plus frozen V1 development evidence. Issue #424 then completed a bounded 2022 development-only smoke pilot with three fully scored candidates and an idempotent rerun that skipped all three completed trial identities.
historical_facts.rules_out: Design-only closures cannot be treated as V2 optimization evidence or champion-selection evidence. The #424 smoke pilot also does not establish a V2 trading edge: all three pilot candidates lost money in the bounded 2022 window.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Any registered V2 variable family, interaction, model role, lifecycle, sizing, risk, execution, or adaptation choice remains eligible for later bounded optimization. The three #424 candidates were execution probes, not an exhaustive family search.

useful_secondary_observations: The #424 smoke pilot scored expanding-mean-v1 and ridge-core-a10 at -$4,450 net and histgb-core-v1 at -$4,400 net over the bounded 2022 development window; histgb-core-v1 was only least negative, not a promoted champion.
remaining_untested_roles: Lifecycle, sizing, risk, execution and adaptation optimization
revisit_trigger: Revisit the harness contract if a registered variable cannot be represented without weakening PIT, chronological-selection, trial-accounting, or executable-cost semantics.
programme_interpretation: Issue #424 is infrastructure and bounded development pilot evidence only; later V2 execution slices must consume it without opening protected confirmation or prospective evidence.
selection_basis: Primary optimization objective is reproducible monthly net return after costs with mandatory risk, stability, concentration, and execution diagnostics.

issue_424: Use only development or rolling_research_oos evidence.
Stop before any reserved_confirmation or true_forward outcome is accessed.
Pilot only enough candidates to prove deterministic scoring, accounting, and resume behavior.
